caption:
# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface

## Window Title Bar
- Application name: LibreOffice Impress
- Document name: ASIST-Strategic-Plan-Town-Hall.pptx
- Current date and time: Oct 22 23:04
- System tray icons: Bell icon (notifications), volume control, and system menu

## Application Menu Bar
- Menu options: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help

## Toolbar
- Contains multiple tool icons for common functions:
  - File operations (new, open, save, print)
  - Drawing tools (shapes, lines, arrows, basic geometric figures)
  - Text formatting tools (font, color, alignment)
  - Slide management tools (insert, delete, duplicate)
  - Object manipulation tools (group, align, distribute)
  - Special tools (chart, table, image, media, hyperlink)
  - Presentation tools (slide show, transition, animation)

## Left Sidebar: Slides Panel
- Displays thumbnails of all 17 slides in the presentation
- Currently selected slide: Slide 1 (AGENDA)
- Each slide thumbnail includes a small preview of its content
- Slide numbers are visible on the left side of each thumbnail
- Slide 1 is highlighted with a blue border indicating it is active

## Main Slide Area
- Current slide: Slide 1 of 17
- Slide title: AGENDA (large, bold, black text)
- Slide content: A bulleted list with four items:
  - Background
  - Discussion of the draft Strategic Plan
  - Questions for you
  - Next steps
- Footer: A logo and text at the bottom center:
  - Logo: "asis&t" in red cursive font
  - Text: "Association for Information Science and Technology" in smaller black font

## Right Sidebar: Properties Panel
- Panel title: Properties
- Section: Slide
  - Format: Widescreen (dropdown menu)
  - Orientation: Landscape (dropdown menu)
  - Background: None (dropdown menu)
    - Option: Insert Image...
  - Master Slide: Title and Content (dropdown menu)
    - Checkboxes:
      - Master Background (checked)
      - Master Objects (checked)
    - Button: Master View
- Section: Layouts
  - Grid of layout thumbnails (12 total)
  - Each thumbnail shows a different slide layout with title and content areas
  - Layouts are displayed in a 3x4 grid

## Top Notification Bar
- Two blue informational banners:
  - First banner: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with a "Get involved" button and a close (X) button
  - Second banner: "Your donations support our worldwide community." with a "Donate" button and a close (X) button

## Status Bar
- Left side: "Slide 1 of 17"
- Center: "Title and Content"
- Right side:
  - Zoom level: 92%
  - Zoom slider with minus and plus buttons
  - Language setting: English (USA)

## Desktop Environment
- Left dock: Contains application icons including:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress (currently active)
  - GIMP
  - File manager
  - App Store
  - Help icon
  - Trash icon
- Bottom dock: Contains a grid icon for application launcher

## Additional UI Elements
- Window control buttons: Minimize, Maximize, Close (top right corner)
- Scroll bars: Vertical scroll bar on the right side of the slides panel
- Zoom controls: Located in the status bar at the bottom right
- Language indicator: "English (USA)" in the status bar
- Document statistics: "12.48 / 0.52" and "0.00 x 0.00" in the status bar
